answer.reason: The verses tell several chief deeds of Pharaoh of Joseph's lifetime beyond his being king of Egypt.

clauses.english: dreamed of seven fat and seven lean cattle and seven full and seven thin ears of corn
clauses.quote: the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine

clauses.english: set Joseph over all the land of Egypt after he interpreted the dreams
clauses.quote: See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

clauses.english: gave Joseph's father and brothers the land of Goshen to dwell in
clauses.quote: in the land of Goshen let them dwell

doubts: GEN 40:2-21 (the butler and baker, Pharaoh's wrath, birthday feast) could be a further clause; omitted to keep the line to the chief events.
GEN 47:20 (Pharaoh acquiring the land of Egypt) was done by Joseph, so it was omitted as a deed of Pharaoh.
GEN 41:1-7 begins at the dream; the quote chosen is from GEN 41:4.
GEN 47:6 quote uses 'in the land of Goshen let them dwell' with the original capitalisation of 'in' differing; it is taken from the verse's wording.
